parameters: \bMr. Briney: Ah, \PN!\nIt's been too long!
\bAye, since I met you, this old sea dog's\nbeen
feeling frisky!
\bSo I've decided to help Dock make\na ferry.
\bAye, after all, a ferry would be able\nto carry a lot
of people.
\bBut, you know, that Dock is really\nsomething
special.
\bWith his knack for technology and\nmy experience,
I'm sure that we can\nbuild one great ship, aye!
move_random_range(1,2)
\bDesigning a large ship is more like\nmaking a big
building than putting\ntogether a transportation
vehicle.
move_random_range(1,2)
\bDon't you think it's strange that\na ship made of
heavy iron floats?
\bIt floats because of a principle\ncalled buoyancy.
\bUmm… If this goes here, and that\ngoes over
there…
\bThen where does this thing go?\nAnd what about
that doohickey?
\bAaargh! I can't make heads or tails\nof this!
\bHm?\nHi, I'm Dock.
\bCapt. Stern commissioned me to\ndesign a ferry.
\bOh! That there…\nAre they Devon Goods?
\bBut, hmm…\nThis won't do…
\bCapt. Stern went off somewhere.\nHe said he had
some work to do.
\bCould I get you to go find Capt.\nStern and deliver
that to him?
A
\bDock: Where could Capt. Stern have\ngone off to?
\bCould you go find Capt. Stern and\ndeliver that
parcel to him?
\bDock: Shipbuilding is an art.
\bA lot of things can't be figured out\njust by
calculating.
\bI really could use advice from a veteran\nwho
knows the seas…
\bDock: Hi! Mr. Briney's joined us to\nlend us his help.
\bThanks to the veteran sailor, the\nferry is steadily
coming together.
\bDock: The ferry is finally ready!
\bThe new S.S. Tidal is truly a marvel\nof technology!
\bBut, I get the feeling that we can\nmake something
even better.
\bYou know, there's never an end to\ntechnology's
march.
A blueprint of some sort?\nIt's too complicated!
A blueprint of some sort?\nIt's too complicated!
\bThe seasons, the weather, where\nthe moon sits in
the sky…
\bThese and other conditions make\nthe sea change
its expression.
\bThat's right!\nThe sea is like a living thing!
A blueprint of some sort?\nIt's too complicated!
\bI get seasick real easily.\nSo I get to help out here
instead.
move_random_range(1,0)
